outcome.answer: The closest matches are papers on self-awareness and consciousness-related reporting in language models [4, 5, 8, 9, 10]. [4] studies when self-referential prompting elicits structured first-person reports of subjective experience, while explicitly saying this is not direct evidence of consciousness. [5] benchmarks metacognition, self-awareness, social awareness, and situational awareness, and finds these are distinct capabilities. [8], [9], and [10] focus on model beliefs, behavioral self-awareness, and meta-cognitive monitoring, showing that models can report on internal states or learned behaviors.
